messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Streaming SLO breach detected for pool 'shared-usw-01' — p99 latency > 2.5s and p95 elevated. Start: ~12:03 UTC. Affected route: /v1/generate (streaming). Severity: P1. Pager: @ava oncall
ava oncall: oncall-ava here, ack. pulling metrics and recent deploys now.
katie (sre): seeing correlated rise in host iowait and GPU stall counters on nodes n-usw-05..n-usw-09. p99 spikes line up with KV cache evictions.
sam (eng-runtime): any recent model rollouts or quantization changes on that pool?
pranay (ml): no model changes this morning. traffic patterns show a small number of tenants with large streaming sessions (long context, ~8k tokens).
igor (infra): I'm seeing heavy nvme writeback on n-usw-07, blkio stats show bursty write throughput from container t-3421 (tenant id). possible noisy neighbor.
ava oncall: summary of impact? customer-facing?
joy (cs): quick check — two customers reported degraded streaming (token drops, stalls) via support webhooks in the last 10m. both on shared pool. marking high touch customers for a follow-up.
katie (sre): metrics snapshot (approx):
```
pool=shared-usw-01 p95=820ms p99=2.8s streaming-stalls=120/s kv-evictions=540/min
host n-usw-07 iowait=18% gpu-stalls=4% nvme_write_mb/s=420
```
ava oncall: initiating live mitigation plan: 1) rate-limit/soft-throttle noisy tenant(s) 2) trigger evictor to move long-lived streams 3) raise blkio cgroup QoS for affected hosts 4) notify CS.
sam (eng-runtime): I can push a quick tenant throttle rule. propose: cap concurrent streaming sessions for t-3421 -> 2, token throughput -> 80% for 5m. anyone object?
pranay (ml): that will reduce cost/perf but good for availability. also suggest temporarily disable KV prefix caching for that tenant to avoid cache pressure (we can do per-tenant cache policy).
igor (infra): on host side I'll increase blkio weight for the workload slice `tenant.slice/t-3421` from 100 -> 500 and set `io.max` limits to 100mb:write per cgroup. preparing commands.
ops-bot: Command queued: `evictor migrate --tenant t-3421 --target reserved-usw-02 --force-fallback` (manual approval required).
ava oncall: approve evictor migration? we should be careful about transient failures.
katie (sre): approve. better to move them than let the pool keep degrading. starting graceful drain on their sessions first.
sam (eng-runtime): throttle rule applied:
```
POST /control/tenants/t-3421/rate_limit
{ "streaming_concurrent": 2, "token_rate_pct": 80, "duration_sec": 300 }
```
sam (eng-runtime): results — CPU and token rate for t-3421 dropped ~65% within 30s.
igor (infra): blkio weight bumped and `io.max` set on n-usw-07 for slice. monitoring iowait.
pranay (ml): toggled per-tenant cache policy: `cache_mode=best-effort` for t-3421. KV evictions down ~40%.
ava oncall: ops-bot, start evictor migration (force) once drain hits <5 active sessions.
ops-bot: Evictor migration started -> migrating 3 live streams. streaming fallback enabled (buffered tokens will be forwarded).
katie (sre): note — we observed a streaming stall pattern where the tail latency jumps when nvme queue depth > 80%. Likely writes from checkpointing + tenant writeback causing queue buildup.
pranay (ml): for long-term we should add adaptive throttling for long-context sessions and encourage dedicated for heavy users. but today need quick containment.
joy (cs): notifying affected customers now: short templated message + offer mitigation and follow-up.
nick (product): do we have customers currently on reserved vs shared? can CS offer migration to reserved capacity?
ava oncall: joy, include migration offer and ETA for full resolution.
ops-bot: Evictor migration completed: all active sessions moved to reserved-usw-02. No failed streams reported.
katie (sre): post-mitigation metrics (2m after migration): p95=340ms p99=720ms streaming-stalls=12/s kv-evictions=60/min. host iowait on n-usw-07 down to 3%.
ava oncall: great — SLOs recovering. moving to containment -> recovery -> postmortem.
sam (eng-runtime): recording the temporary rules we applied:
```
- throttle t-3421 streaming to 2 concurrent
- cache_mode=t-3421 -> best-effort
- blkio io.max set on n-usw-07
- evictor migrated tenant -> reserved-usw-02
```
igor (infra): follow-ups for infra: investigate why writeback exploded (which process, checkpoint cadence), consider host-level writeback tuning (vm.dirty_ratio/dirty_background_ratio) and NVMe queue depth monitoring.
pranay (ml): follow-ups for runtime/ML: implement per-tenant long-context detection and adaptive sampling/cutoff to avoid runaway KV growth; flag heavy token users for product + billing.
nick (product): will evaluate migration incentives and thresholds for auto-migrate to reserved when sustained heavy streaming observed.
joy (cs): logged affected customers and started outreach. will coordinate status updates.
ava oncall: handing off to day-shift: @sam (eng-runtime) owns incident until postmortem. include remediation tasks and customer notes in incident doc. closing immediate P1 page but keeping thread open for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
